title: Teal Floral Print Cotton Anarkali Midi Dress
description:
Feroza means “turquoise” – a fresh teal dress that moves with you.

A soft cotton midi dress in teal, printed all over with white florals and trailing vines.

• Round neck and 3/4 sleeves – easy, covered and comfortable
• Fitted bodice with a gathered empire waist that opens into a full Anarkali-style flare
• Calf length, light and breathable for warm days, brunch, office and holidays
• Sizes XS–3XL, or stitched to your measurements free of charge

Care: gentle hand wash in cold water, dry in shade.
